Preview your license plate

Choose a standard or custom plate design with DOL-assigned or personalized characters.

Preview only. DOL determines plate availability, eligibility, and final approval. Designs that cannot be personalized remain available to view.

The live preview requires JavaScript. You can still browse DOL’s official plate catalog and read the personalized plate rules.

A free addition for an existing website

This community contribution uses plain HTML, scoped CSS, and JavaScript. It includes the complete published catalog, unchanged original sample images, locally hosted fonts, integration guidance, and source attribution. There are no accounts, trackers, saved preferences, or background availability checks.

The code is MIT licensed. Official artwork and open-license fonts retain their separate rights. The original samples are exact copies; customized lettering and reconstructed background pixels are approximate until DOL provides approved blank templates and the manufacturing font.
